mechanism.claim: In an already high-volatility BTC regime, a published Crypto Fear & Greed extreme represents sentiment-linked liquidity withdrawal and overreaction. Extreme fear is faded long and extreme greed is faded short for one day.
mechanism.side: long when the lagged published index is <=25; short when it is >=75

external_support.paper: Farzulla (2026), The Extremity Premium: Sentiment Regimes and Adverse Selection in Cryptocurrency Markets
external_support.supported_fact: fear and greed extremes exhibit uncertainty-linked liquidity withdrawal beyond neutral regimes
external_support.untested_adaptation: extreme states are tested as contrarian BTC return signals

mechanism.why_distinct: No prior repository alpha uses the Alternative.me Fear & Greed history. FGER uses a daily behavioral state, not price-only range, flow, funding, options, or a terminal control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC prior-24h realized variation must rank at least 0.65 causally
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one-day-lagged sentiment-extreme entries at 00:05 UTC are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.index_source: Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed historical JSON
features.availability: an index row labeled UTC date D is not usable until D+1 00:00 UTC, regardless of API timestamp
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open)) over exact BTCUSDT 1m bars [D,D+1d) completed at D+1 00:00 UTC
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 90 prior daily variations; minimum 60; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.missing_duplicate_or_conflicting: ineligible or source failure; no imputation

clock.decision: daily 00:00 UTC after the one-day-lagged index and prior BTC day are complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published sentiment-extremity mechanism plus standard provider category boundaries and user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, lag, direction, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
